summary: Examples of the comment filter with the default plain style and a custom prefix/postfix style.
questions: What does the comment filter output by default?
How do I create a custom-styled comment banner?

answer_card.title: comment filter examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
commented: "{{ 'Plain style (default)' | comment }}"
# =>
# #
# # Plain style (default)
# #

verycustom: "{{ 'Custom style' | comment('plain', prefix='#######\n#', postfix='#\n#######\n   ###\n    #') }}"
```
